name: PAW Patrol
description: Marshall, Rocky, Rubble, Zuma and Skye are doing their best to protect the people of their town. Led by Ryder, a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy, each of them is equipped with special equipment and together they help anyone who finds themselves in trouble. No task is too big for them and no puppy is too small.

credits_cast.character: Skye in great British version season 14 and onwards
credits_cast.name: Majestie lewton ll

videos.title: Mighty Pups
videos.overview: In this high-flying, heroic mission, the PAW Patrol are given Mighty Pup powers after a mysterious meteor lands in Adventure Bay. When Mayor Humdinger and his nephew trap Ryder and steal the meteor to take over the city, the pups must work together and use their new powers–from Chase's super speed to Marshall's mighty heat, Rubble's super strength and more–to race to the rescue and save the day.

videos.title: Marshall's Rusty Makeover
videos.overview: Rusty from Rusty Rivets gives Marshall's firetruck a makeover.

videos.title: Ready, Race, Rescue
videos.overview: It’s the Adventure Bay 500! The pups are ready to be the pit crew for their race hero, The Whoosh! When the legendary racer is unable to drive in the championship race, he calls on Marshall to take the wheel and race in his place!

videos.title: Charged Up: Pups vs. the Super Sonic Sound System
videos.overview: Chase and Rocky take on a maniacal musical menace: DJ Harold Humdinger's Super Sonic Sound System.

videos.title: Charged Up: Pups vs. a Copy Cat Marshall
videos.overview: It's up to "Charged Up" Mighty Marshall to clear his name when Copy Cat steals Marshall's vehicle and impersonates him, melting everything in his path with his heat paw power.

videos.title: Charged Up: Pups vs. the Teenybots
videos.overview: "Charged Up" Rubble goes wrecking-balling for Teenybots when Copy Cat and Harold team up and lead a small army of minirobot minions in an invasion of Adventure Bay.

videos.title: Charged Up: Pups vs. a Super Meow Meow
videos.overview: "Charged Up" Skye and Zuma square off against a cyclonic catastrophe-causing robo-kitty when Harold reactivates "Meow Meow," super-powering it up with a meteor shard.

videos.title: Charged Up: Pups vs. a Teleporting Copy Cat
videos.overview: When the Copy Cat copies Harold's robot's teleporting powers, it's up to "Charged Up" Rocky and his X-ray vision to find him and Chase's sonic bark to save the day.

videos.title: Charged Up: Pups Save a Super-Powered Puplantis
videos.overview: When Harold's failed attempt to steal the meteor lands it in Puplantis, it's up to "Charged Up" Zuma and Skye to get it back where it belongs before the superpowered pearls give away the secret of the Mer-pups.

videos.title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Tromping Triceratops
videos.overview: Mayor Goodway takes a selfie with Chickaletta, startling a triceratops into tromping right toward the raptor nesting grounds; a Dino Rescue is launched to save the eggs and stop the stomper.

videos.title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Baby Stegosaurus
videos.overview: When Humdinger swipes the Dino Patroller and endangers a school of baby stegosauri, it's up to Ryder, Rex and the Pups to come to the Dino Rescue.

videos.title: Jet to the Rescue
videos.overview: The PAW Patrol, along with the royal pup Sweetie, must help the Princess of Barkingburg defend the land on her birthday from the Duke of Flappington, the Princess of Barkingburg's cousin, who had acquired the power of a mighty levitation gem to combined to his own. This leads to Skye to face off her fear of eagles and lead the PAW Patrol into their biggest aerial rescue.

videos.title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Pterodactyl Egg
videos.overview: A pterodactyl mother and her egg become trapped on a ledge after a rock slide.

videos.title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Dino Christmas
videos.overview: Christmas in Dino World is interrupted when a volcano causes a landslide that traps a Brachiosaurus, and it's up to Ryder and the Pups to come to the Dino Rescue.

videos.title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save the Baby Raptors
videos.overview: A baby raptor gets inside the Dino Lookout, which causes commotion; Rex and Zuma race to save the raptor's siblings, and Ryder and the Pups search for its parents.

videos.title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Tyrannosaurus' Birthday
videos.overview: A surprise birthday party for a Tyrannosaurus turns into a dino rescue when the startled guest of honour stomps off, getting stuck in a pit full of quicksand.

videos.title: Cat Pack - Rubble and Wild and Yarn Ball
videos.overview: Rubble and Wild rescue animals from a giant runaway ball of yarn.

videos.title: Cat Pack - Skye and Rory Flip It
videos.overview: Skye and Rory rescue Cora the painter hanging from a scaffold.

videos.title: Cat Pack - Marshall, Leo and a Ferris Wheel
videos.overview: Marshall and Leo must rescue some critters stuck on a Ferris wheel.

videos.title: Cat Pack - Everest, Shade and the Mountain Goat
videos.overview: Everest and Shade rescue a baby mountain goat stuck in a crevasse.

videos.title: Pups Stop a Big Leak
videos.overview: The pups help Cap'n Turbot and cousin Francois plug a water tower leak.

videos.title: Pups Save a Baby Anteater
videos.overview: A baby anteater's fingers get stuck to a galloping robotic pony.

videos.title: Pups Save a Hatch Day
videos.overview: The Pups rescue Ace and her special delivery for Chickaletta's party

videos.title: Pups Save the Munchie Mobile
videos.overview: The pups rescue Mr. Porter and his stranded Food Truck.

videos.title: Valiente: A Tracker Story
videos.overview: Tracker and Carlos come across a series of nocturnal animals fleeing the scariest part of the region - the Shadow Jungle - Tracker must brave his fear of the dark and stop a new villain, Lucita Mala, who believes the entire jungle belongs to her!

videos.title: A PAW Patrol Christmas
videos.overview: Santa gets ill, Christmas is cancelled in Adventure Bay, Mayor Humdinger goes to the North Pole to take all the gifts for himself. Rubble and the rest of the PAW Patrol will have to make a sacrifice to stop Mayor Humdinger from ruining Christmas!

videos.title: Rocky's Cat-astrophe
videos.overview: When one of Humdinger's schemes goes awry, a Junkyard Kitten's home is destroyed and Rocky bites off more than he can chew when he invites the kitten to stay at the Lookout overnight. While the kitten causes more trouble than expected, Rocky learns that even heroes need help.

videos.title: Pups and the Kitty-tastrophe
videos.overview: A kitten named Precious is floating out to sea, and the PAW Patrol must rescue her, but that's not all. The PAW Patrol must also act fast to find her owner before the mischievous kitten gets into big trouble.

videos.title: Pups Save a Train
videos.overview: The train that Katie and Cali are on is stuck on a bridge because of a rock slide. The PAW Patrol must act fast since the broken bridge beam can't hold the train for long!

videos.title: Pup Pup Boogie
videos.overview: A train car falls off the tracks and also breaks some rails. A train is coming later with important packages in it, with the all new Pup Pup Boogie 2.0 dance game. The PAW Patrol tries to fix the tracks, but how will they fix the tracks when Rubble sprains his paw and can't work? Can Chase save the day?

videos.title: Pups in a Fog
videos.overview: While the pups are having a sleepover, the Lighthouse light runs out of power. Cap'n Turbot, the one who monitors the Lighthouse light, is out at sea.

videos.title: Pups Save the Sea Turtles
videos.overview: Baby sea turtles were hatching at the other side of the road near the beach. They can't get to the beach without crossing the street, there are cars, skateboarders, scooters and all the hungry naughty seagulls around, not to mention Alex's rambunctious antics.

videos.title: Pups and the Very Big Baby
videos.overview: A baby whale has beached herself. The PAW Patrol has to rescue her and make sure her mother doesn't get too close. Can they save her and reunite her with her mother?

videos.title: Pups Save the Circus
videos.overview: Ellie, the baby elephant from the Circus train, has escaped and is loose in Adventure Bay!

videos.title: Pup a Doodle Do
videos.overview: Mayor Goodway's purse chicken, Chickaleta, is on the loose and the PAW Patrol must find her before it's too late for Mayor Goodway and Chickaleta to host Hello, Adventure Bay.

videos.title: Pup Pup Goose
videos.overview: When a flock of migrating geese stops in Adventure Bay, Marshall bonds with Fuzzy, the gosling of the flock.

videos.title: Pup Pup and Away
videos.overview: Mayor Goodway has entered the Mayor's Hot Air Balloon Race, and she wants to beat the arrogant Mayor Humdinger of Foggy Bottom, but her balloon has a hole in it.

videos.title: Pups Pit Crew
videos.overview: The pups help a young boy named Alex fix his broken tricycle and teach him a valuable lesson of taking new things slow.

videos.title: Pups Fight Fire
videos.overview: The pups helps Marshall prepare for a firefighting obstacle course to win the fastest fire pup trophy.

videos.title: Pups Save the Bunnies
videos.overview: A bunch of adorable bunnies have come to Farmer Yumi's carrot patch. The PAW Patrol must catch them all and relocate them to a perfect new home.

videos.title: Pup-Tacular
videos.overview: While the rest of the PAW Patrol are out to rescue Mayor Goodway and Chickaleta and checking the trucks, Rocky must face his hydrophobia so that Katie can enter him in the Pup-Tacular Show.

videos.title: Pups Save the Bay
videos.overview: There's an oil spill in the bay, and a Baby Whale swam into the oil. The PAW Patrol must clean up the Baby Whale and the oil spill before more animals living in Adventure Bay are harmed by it.

videos.title: Pups Save a Goodway
videos.overview: It's Great-Great-Great-Great-Grandpa Grover Day, and Mayor Goodway has been planning anxiously for today's celebration.

videos.title: Pups Get a Rubble
videos.overview: This episode is a flashback story of how Rubble joined the PAW Patrol. Rubble must help Jake when he gets trapped in an Avalanche.

videos.title: Pups Save a Walrus
videos.overview: The playful walrus, Wally, was performing tricks for Cap'n Turbot, but he eventually gets himself tangled in a fishing net during one of his tricks.

videos.title: Pups Save the Treats
videos.overview: On a snow and icy day, Mr. Porter's van ends up sliding on ice. If the ice cracks, it will fall into the bottom of the bay, and inside of the truck has all the pups' treats and food in it!

videos.title: Pups Get a Lift
videos.overview: Katie and Cali are stuck on Jake's Mountain. Rubble wants Ryder to pick him but he picks Marshall and Rocky.

videos.title: Pups Save a Hoedown
videos.overview: The PAW Patrol are having a great time at the Adventure Bay Hoedown, but trouble starts to brew when Farmer Al's cows get spooked out and are on the loose in Adventure Bay.

videos.title: Pups Save Alex
videos.overview: While Cali is playing with her favorite toy on Farmer Yumi's farm, she gets stuck on the top of the silo, which is not safe.

videos.title: Pups and the Ghost Pirate
videos.overview: A Halloween party turns into a spooky time when there's a ghostly figure roaming around on a ship. Can the PAW Patrol solve the paranormal mystery and save the Halloween party?

videos.title: Pups Save a School Day
videos.overview: It's Alex's first day of school, but he has lost his backpack! So the PAW Patrol agrees to help him find it.

videos.title: Pups Turn On the Lights
videos.overview: It's Chase's birthday and the other pups and Katie are setting up Chase's surprise birthday party at Katie's Clinic.

videos.title: Pups Save a Pool Day
videos.overview: It's a hot day and the pups head for the water park, but the pool is empty! The water tower that pumps water into the pool is tilted and has a bent pipe.

videos.title: Circus Pup-formers
videos.overview: The PAW Patrol, for the first time, must all work together to help Eunice and Ellie save the circus when most of the performers are late.

videos.title: Pups Make a Splash
videos.overview: Cap'n Turbot got The Flounder stuck on some rocks. If the PAW Patrol doesn't save him, The Flounder will sink to the bottom of the bay!

videos.title: Pups Fall Festival
videos.overview: Ryder and the PAW Patrol have to save Farmer Yumi's fruit before an early snowfall comes. Everyone has a job to do to help, except for Chase.

videos.title: Pups Save Christmas
videos.overview: Santa's sleigh crashes and breaks in a snow storm on Christmas Eve, and all the presents are strewn across Adventure Bay. It's up to the PAW Patrol to fix the sled, collect the reindeer, find the gifts, find the magic star, and most importantly, save Christmas for Adventure Bay.

videos.title: Pups On Ice
videos.overview: Ryder and the PAW Patrol need to rescue Alex on Jakes mountain.

videos.title: Pups and the Snow Monster
videos.overview: The pups find strange footprints in the snow on the mountain outside Adventure Bay. Everyone thinks it's a "snow monster" and it's scaring the skiers away.

videos.title: Pups Save a Super Pup
videos.overview: Rubble is pretending to be a super pup and tries to handle a rescue all by himself, but soon, Ryder and the Paw Patrol have to save Rubble.

videos.title: Pups Save Ryder's Robot
videos.overview: When Ryder's Robot Pup breaks and starts going wild around Adventure Bay, it takes the whole Paw Patrol to help Ryder find it.

videos.title: Pups Go All Monkey
videos.overview: An escaped baby monkey named Mandy leads the PAW Patrol on a chase through Adventure Bay, when she steals Mr. Porter van full of bananas.

videos.title: Pups Save a Hoot
videos.overview: Chase befriends a baby owl and with the PAW Patrol helps rescue its mother who is trapped in the knothole of a fallen tree.

videos.title: Pups Save a Bat
videos.overview: A baby Bat decides to take a nap hanging from the Town Hall's bell and Mayor Goodway can't ring it. Ryder and the Pups attempt to rescue the bat quietly so it doesn't wake up, but it does and causes trouble around town. It's up to Ryder and the Pups to get the Bat and return her to her Bat cave.

videos.title: Pups Save a Toof
videos.overview: Alex is afraid to go to the dentist, so Chase and the PAW Patrol work together to show Alex that fears can be overcome.

videos.title: Pups Save the Easter Egg Hunt
videos.overview: It’s Adventure Bay’s annual Easter Egg Hunt and the pups are helping Mayor Goodway with the egg decorating. The hunt for a very special egg leads Ryder and the PAW Patrol on an exciting adventure.

videos.title: Pups and the Lighthouse Boogie
videos.overview: Cap'n Turbot has accidentally locked himself inside the lighthouse, so it is up to the pups to rescue a rowboat drifting out to sea.

videos.title: Pups Save Ryder
videos.overview: When Ryder and a goat named Garbi are trapped on a ledge at Big View Trail, it is up to the pups to save them.

videos.title: Pups Great Race
videos.overview: It's Adventure Bay Race Day and the pups are about to race each other all across the town to see who is the fastest pup. One other competitor unexpectedly shows up though, Alex in his super trike!

videos.title: Pups Take the Cake
videos.overview: Mr.Porter enters a cake competition and needs Ryder and the pups to help him bake the biggest and tastiest cake. The race is on to get their cake baked and to the competition on time!

videos.title: Pups and the Beanstalk
videos.overview: Rubble has a wondrous dream, similar to Jack and the Beanstalk, where Marshall grows a giant beanstalk and Alex is a giant. However, when giant Alex starts to cause havoc, Ryder and the PAW Patrol must keep him occupied.

videos.title: Pups Save the Turbots
videos.overview: When Cap'n Turbot needs to get a picture of the rare Blue Footed Booby Bird when his French cousin, Francois Turbot, decides to help but gets caught on a cliff! It's up to the PAW Patrol to rescue him and bring the two cousins together again.

videos.title: Pups Save the Camping Trip
videos.overview: When Chickaletta falls in a cave in the ground it's up to the PAW Patrol to save her!

videos.title: Pups and the Trouble with Turtles
videos.overview: Tons of baby turtles are popping up all over the town. Can the PAW Patrol help get them back to their homes before they get hurt?

videos.title: Pups Save the Space Alien
videos.overview: An alien lands on Earth at Farmer Yumi's place, and the gang try to repair his spaceship so he can return home.

videos.title: Pups Save a Flying Frog
videos.overview: Marshall gets a pet frog, and it jumps into a helicopter prior to a big frog-jumping competition.

videos.title: Pups and the Pirate Treasure
videos.overview: Cap'n Turbot accidentally stumbles into a secret cavern that was once a pirate's hideout. When the PAW Patrol rescues him, they find an incomplete treasure map. The adventure is on as the pups follow clues to find the missing map pieces, and eventually to an amazing sunken pirate treasure!

videos.title: Pups Save the Penguins
videos.overview: The pups must find a way to get a group of penguins back to the South Pole.

videos.title: Pups Save a Dolphin Pup
videos.overview: The PAW Patrol must help a Baby Dolphin get back into the bay with her parents.

videos.title: Pups Save Jake
videos.overview: The PAW Patrol must rescue Jake when his ankle gets stuck between some fallen rocks.

videos.title: Pups Save the Parade
videos.overview: Katie's bathtub float floats away when Alex puts too many balloons on it during Adventure Bay Day.

videos.title: Pups Save the Diving Bell
videos.overview: The PAW Patrol uses Zuma's new submarine to help Cap'n Turbot.

videos.title: Pups Save the Beavers
videos.overview: When a storm washes away Chompy the Beaver's dam, he starts chomping wood all over town.

videos.title: Pups Save a Ghost
videos.overview: A mysterious Ghost is causing havoc around the Lookout at night. The Pups and Chase in his new SPY GEAR set up a stakeout to bust it.

videos.title: Pups Save a Show
videos.overview: The Pups are going to put on a Medieval play in town square, but Cap'n Turbot's castle stage prop ends up collapsing and trapping him!

videos.title: Pups Save an Ace
videos.overview: Skye's favorite stunt pilot, Ace Sorensen, is heading to Adventure Bay to put on a fantastic air show. Just before arrival she runs into engine trouble!

videos.title: Pups Save a Wedding
videos.overview: Farmer Al and Farmer Yumi are getting married! Farmer Yumi's barn is being decorated for the big day and all the pups are helping, but a big storm blows in and takes down a wall of the barn!

videos.title: The New Pup
videos.overview: An Arctic storm picks up, but Jake finds help from a brave mountain ranger pup named Everest!

videos.title: Pups Jungle Trouble
videos.overview: The PAW Patrol heads to the Jungle in the PAW Patroller to meet Ryder's 10 year old pen-pal, Carlos.

videos.title: Pups Save a Herd
videos.overview: Chase is taking part in a herding competition and starts to herd people around town as practice which causes more trouble than good.

videos.title: Pups and the Big Freeze
videos.overview: A wintertime storm causes trouble all over Adventure Bay.

videos.title: Pups Save a Basketball Game
videos.overview: Marshall is nervous about playing in the PAW Patrol basketball team. Chase lets Marshall sit out, but when Zuma and Rocky get injured, Marshall is forced to take over.

videos.title: Pups Save a Talent Show
videos.overview: It's Adventure Bay Talent Show Day! Mayor Goodway is excited but afraid there won't be enough acts! Ryder's super talented pups can definitely help out.

videos.title: Pups Save the Corn Roast
videos.overview: Ryder and the Pups help Farmer Al prepare his annual Corn Roast, complete with a Corn Field Maze! Bettina accidentally tips over some hot BBQ coals onto the piles of corn that begin to pop, pop, POP into piles of POPCORN!

videos.title: Pups Leave Marshall Home Alone
videos.overview: Ryder and the Pups head out for a day of Parachute training, but Marshall decides to stay back because of his fear of heights.

videos.title: Pups Save the Deer
videos.overview: Cap'n Turbot goes out ice fishing and finds a family of Deer stuck on the slippery ice! They must have tried to get across the frozen Bay for food! Ryder and the PAW Patrol to the rescue!

videos.title: Pups Save a Friend
videos.overview: Feeling like his clumsy ways are constantly messing up his friends' fun, Marshall decides to take a break from the PAW Patrol and goes off into the woods. Once the pups notice Marshall is gone, they jump to action to find him and bring him back to the Lookout.

videos.title: Pups Save a Stowaway
videos.overview: The PAW Patrol is on another road trip--this time to the icy tundra to help Jake count penguins.

videos.title: Pups Save the Parrot
videos.overview: Ryder and the PAW Patrol head to the Jungle in the PAW PATROLLER to help their good friend CARLOS find his lost Parrot, Matea!

videos.title: Pups Save the Queen Bee
videos.overview: When Cap'n Turbot notices the light in his lighthouse isn't working properly, he discovers it's bee-cause a BIG beehive is inside it!

videos.title: Pups' Adventures in Babysitting
videos.overview: Mayor Goodway has her hands full with her twin niece and nephew Julia and Julius. She calls on the PAW Patrol to rescue them from a tree, and then twin sit for the day!

videos.title: Pups Save the Fireworks
videos.overview: Mayor Goodway receives a package of piglets instead of the fireworks she was expecting. It turns out that the mailman has been making sloppy deliveries as he keeps delivering each package to the wrong address.

videos.title: Pups Save an Elephant Family
videos.overview: The Pups are on a PAW Patroller road trip to the Savana where they meet up with Photo Safari fans Cap'n Turbot and his cousin François Turbot. In the middle of the night the campers are awakened by an intruder who turns out to be a lost baby elephant - Gilda.

videos.title: Pups and the Mischievous Kittens
videos.overview: Adventure Bay has been picked as a Finalist in the Tidiest Town Contest and looks like they're going to win! That is until Mayor Humdinger unleashes his Kitten Catastrophe Crew and those naughty kittens mess up everything in sight.

videos.title: Pups Save a Mer-Pup
videos.overview: When the Pups and Cap'n Turbot camp out under the very rare Magical Mer Moon, magical things begin to happen. Lured by the mystical Mer pup song and then transformed into Mer pups themselves, Skye and Zuma and even water resistant Rocky perform an underwater rescue in a sunken old ship. Cap'n Turbot and Ryder help out by diving deep to bottom of the Bay in their Diving Bell to help a Mer Mom and pup.

videos.title: Pups Save a Sniffle
videos.overview: The PAW Patrol is just about to zoom off on their latest rescue to help Farmer Al capture his run-a-way pigs, Emma and Corny, when Chase sneezes, then Zuma sneezes and in a blink of an eye, Skye joins the group of sick puppies.

videos.title: Pups and the Ghost Cabin
videos.overview: It's spooky good times as Jake is cleaning up an old miner's cabin in the woods to revamp it as a ski chalet! Rubble and Rocky are happy to lend a helping hand, that is until their lunch disappears.

videos.title: Pups Save an Adventure
videos.overview: Alex is working towards getting his Action Scouts Fire Safety Badge, and who better to help him learn all about Fire Safety than Marshall and the PAW Patrol!

videos.title: Pups Save a Surprise
videos.overview: It's just another regular day in Adventure Bay as the PAW Patrol is called to duty. First they have to help Mr. Porter who has his rump stuck in a stump which turns out to be the home of a neighborhood skunk!

videos.title: Pups Save the Mayor's Race
videos.overview: It's the annual Mayor's Race and Mayor Goodway is determined to give it her best.

videos.title: Pups Save an Outlaw's Loot
videos.overview: Ryder helps Mayor Goodway sort through the old cabin of Outlaw Wild Wilbur when they come across a map for his buried treasure.

videos.title: Pups Save Walinda
videos.overview: The PAW Patrol must come to the rescue when Wally's special friend, Walinda, gets tangled in an anchor chain.

videos.title: Pups Save a Big Bone
videos.overview: Cap'n Turbot and his cousin are in the middle of an archaeological dig when the cliff they are on collapses all around them.

videos.title: Pups Save a Floundering Francois
videos.overview: Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are watching white whales in Adventure Bay when their boat hits a rock and starts to sink.

videos.title: Pups Save the Pop-Up Penguins
videos.overview: The PAW Patrol must track down some loose penguins and help them return to the land of ice and snow.

videos.title: Pups Save a Pizza
videos.overview: While delivering special pizza dough for a party, Alex and Mr. Porter get into an accident.

videos.title: Pups Save Skye
videos.overview: A storm causes Skye to crash land in the snow while on her way to Jake's Mountain.

videos.title: Pups Save the Woof and Roll Show
videos.overview: When a storm blows through the town right before a concert, the pups must work together to clean up the mess.

videos.title: Pups Save an Eagle
videos.overview: Mayor Goodway's backpack slips down the side of a cliff with Chickaletta in it.

videos.title: Pups Bark with Dinosaurs
videos.overview: The PAW Patrol is on a big excavation dig in the jungle with Cap'n Turbot looking for dinosaur fossils when they unearth 3 fossilized eggs. Before they know what's happening the eggs start to hatch and there are three baby pterodactyls running around Adventure Bay!

videos.title: Pup-Fu!
videos.overview: While Sensei Yumi teaches all the Pups the ancient art of Pup-Fu, Mayor Humdinger steals an ancient scroll that holds all the secrets of the art.

videos.title: Pups Find a Genie
videos.overview: Rubble Finds an old brass Jack-in-the-box with a Genie inside who grants him 3 wishes.

videos.title: Pups Save a Tightrope Walker
videos.overview: Francois tries to walk a tightrope from Adventure Bay's Bridge to the Lookout.

videos.title: Pups Save a Snowboard Competition
videos.overview: Jake and Everest are excited today's the day of the big Snowboard Competition, until they look outside and see the course is completely buried under blanket of snow.

videos.title: Pups Save a Chicken of the Sea
videos.overview: The Cap'n is about to test it out in an underwater adventure when Chickaletta, Cali and a seagull beat him to it. All the animal activity on the control panel drives the diving bell to the bottom of the bay.

videos.title: Pups Save the Soccer Game
videos.overview: The pups discover that their opponents in a soccer match are cheating.

videos.title: Pups Save a Lucky Collar
videos.overview: Marshall wins a supposedly lucky collar, leading him to take unnecessary risks while helping Cap'n Turbot save an owl.

videos.title: Air Pups
videos.overview: Cap'n Turbot and Francois go on a monkey communication expedition, but are put in danger when the volcano on the island erupts. The PAW Patrol uses their new Air Patroller to rescue the two, along with a family of monkeys.

videos.title: The Pups Save Friendship Day
videos.overview: While celebrating Friendship Day, the pups must prevent Mayor Humdinger from ruining Adventure Bay's reputation as the friendliest town on the map.

videos.title: Pups Save Alex's Mini-Patrol
videos.overview: The pups prepare for Adventure Bay's Tree Dedication Ceremony and end up receiving help from Alex Porter's newly-formed "mini-patrol."

videos.title: Pups Save a Lost Tooth
videos.overview: The pups' boat ride with Cap'n Turbot is postponed when they must track down a lost tooth.

videos.title: Pups Save Daring Danny X
videos.overview: Ryder uses the Air Patroller to save a wannabe daredevil.

videos.title: Pups in a Fix
videos.overview: Cap'n Turbot's boat, the Flounder, is tuned up by Ryder's robotic pup.

videos.title: Pups Save a Dragon
videos.overview: The PAW Patrol performs a play in which Katie is a princess in a tower.

videos.title: Pups Save Three Little Pigs
videos.overview: Rubble builds a brick house for three pigs on a farm.

videos.title: Pups Save a Goldrush
videos.overview: The pups search for gold using Rocky's makeshift sifting tools.

videos.title: Pups Save the Paw Patroller
videos.overview: The pups take a break from washing the PAW Patroller. When they return, the PAW Patroller is missing.

videos.title: Pups Save Apollo
videos.overview: Rubble dreams about saving his idol, Apollo the Super-Pup, from an evil Spider King.

videos.title: Pups Save the Hippos
videos.overview: Zuma feels left out when he cannot assist in a mission involving a trio of circus hippos.

videos.title: Pups Save the Polar Bears
videos.overview: While on a trip to the Arctic, Cap'n Turbot needs the pups' help to get a family of polar bears back together.

videos.title: A Pup in Sheep's Clothing
videos.overview: Marshall puts on a sheep costume to find missing lambs on a farm.

videos.title: Pups Save a School Bus
